extDescription.message: Keeps pinned tabs the same in every window, and closes tabs you haven't viewed for a while while keeping them searchable (like Arc)

optionsDescription.message: Unpinned tabs you haven't viewed for a while are closed automatically and kept here. The active tab and tabs playing audio are never closed.

archiveGroupedTabsLabel.message: Also close tabs in tab groups

archiveGroupedTabsHelp.message: When off, tabs in a group are kept, like Arc's pinned tabs.

omniboxHelp.message: Type "ar" and Space in the address bar to search archived tabs.

alwaysPinnedHelp.message: When you open a new window, these pages open as pinned tabs. Each window gets its own copy, so page state is not shared. Windows that already have pinned tabs (for example after restarting Chrome) are left as they are.

syncPinnedLabel.message: Keep pinned tabs the same in every window

syncPinnedHelp.message: While on, pinning, unpinning or reordering pinned tabs in one window does the same in the other windows. Closing a pinned tab only affects that window. When off, new windows don't get them either.

commandResetPinnedTab.message: Reset the pinned tab to its saved URL
